notes: Summary: OrionBridge is a mid-market product-analytics SaaS vendor building an in-app conversational assistant and personalization pipeline that uses embeddings + reranking. They completed a 5-week Hosted API trial: integration stable, key team impressed with streaming + function calling. Trial observations: baseline = ~12 QPS (weekday normal), spikes to 78 QPS during a promo event, avg request size ~420 tokens (prompt+context+user history), avg completion ~60 tokens. Primary workflows: user chat (sessioned, KV cache candidate), semantic search for personalization (batch embedding generation), and reranking on top-N candidates. Cost sensitivity: moderate — want predictable unit economics and lower per-token costs at scale.
token_mix_summary: Observed during trial: avg request tokens 420 (75% prompt/context, 25% completion). Embedding jobs are 10-15% of total requests but account for ~35% of token volume due to long docs. They expect user-visible chat to remain ~60% of requests, embeddings ~25%, reranking/batch jobs ~15%. Cacheable prefix tokens estimated to reduce prompt tokens by ~30% for chat sessions.
traffic_forecast_summary: Product team forecast (18 months): baseline QPS grows from current 12 -> 55 in 6 months -> 150 peak in 12 months with burst headroom to 220 QPS during marketing. Concurrency target: p95 concurrent requests ~180 (assuming average response time 250ms). Token/sec forecast (steady-state): ~45k tokens/sec at 150 QPS with caching; peak token/sec estimate ~80k during bursts. Growth assumptions tied to two planned feature launches and one major enterprise win.
dedicated_sizing_recommendation: SE recommendation (Maya): start Dedicated with a 3-node pool (each node ~A40/A100-equivalent), autoscale to 6 nodes under sustained load. Configuration: quantized medium-latency model family (13B quant) for personalization + a fallback 7B variant for cost-sensitive endpoints. Enable KV/prefix caching for the in-app assistant (expect 25-35% token reduction). Networking: VPC peering + egress cap to control costs. Expected runway: this config handles 100-160 steady QPS with 2x burst headroom; additional nodes added when 95th percentile CPU/GPU utilization >70% over 15m. Finance note: estimated monthly committed cost in config ~$20k-$35k depending on reserved term and model mix; aligns with ARR band if 12–18 month contract.
